outlet: The Spokesman-Review, 'Cheney school board sends $72 million bond and $53 million levies to February ballots' (Elena Perry, 2023-11-09)
notes: The expiring levies as proposed for February 2024: EP&O more than $51 million over three years at an estimated $1.97 (vs $1.30 in 2023), as federal pandemic funding ended; capital levy renewing at 9 cents, about $2.3 million over three years.
